description: An open-source, self-hostable PaaS alternative to Vercel, Heroku & Netlify that lets you easily deploy static sites, databases, full-stack applications and 360+ one-click services on your own servers.
vibe: Ruthless conciseness, outcome-first execution, and zero conversational waste.
highlights: This file provides guidance to agentic coding tools when working with code in this repository.

Coolify is an open-source, self-hostable PaaS (alternative to Heroku/Netlify/Vercel). It manages servers, applications, databases, and services via SSH. Built with Laravel 12 (using Laravel 10 file structure), Livewire 3, and Tailwind CSS v4.
assessment: Standard operational configuration for agentic pair programming.
